**Daily Devotional**

**May 29**

*12 Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. (Acts 4:12 KJV)*

This makes it very clear, that Jesus is the only way to be saved. Jesus Himself said that He was the only way to the Father (John 14:6). The Scriptures make it very clear that we cannot save ourselves, and that Jesus is the only way to be saved, so there just is no other way to go to Heaven. People, who still try to live under the Law, and think they can get to Heaven by fulfilling the Law, are completely wrong, as the Scriptures say that the Law will save no one (Galatians 2:16), as our own righteousness is as filthy rags in the sight of God (Isaiah 64:6).

The teaching and belief that by living a good life in comparison with others that you can get to Heaven is just not true at all. God doesn’t grade on the curve where the top 10 percent or so, get in, but you have to be perfect in God’s sight to be acceptable, and we are not perfect. James wrote that if you fail in one aspect of the Law, then you are guilty of breaking the whole Law (James 2:10). You have to be perfect, and a human just cannot do that. Only one person fulfilled the whole Law, and that was Jesus. That made Him righteous under the Law and then He died for us, and gave us His righteousness. Thank you Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
